title: Refit an outdoor load center deadfront through its side guides and secure the lower screw
instruction: On the unpowered panel, insert the top of the inner deadfront above both side guides at about 45 degrees, bring the bottom in over the breakers, secure the lower-right screw using the driver and release the cover.
context: An electrician refits the inner deadfront after servicing a residential outdoor load center. The Leviton installation guide shows a separate inner plate entering both side guides with its bottom tilted toward the installer. The bottom then swings inward and is secured with one screw. This training panel has no supply connection.
setup: Two standard YAM arms share the station table. A Leviton LR222-LDD enclosure is fixed upright on a backboard with its weather door removed. Six OFF LB120-T breakers occupy the top three spaces of both columns. The matching LRDFC-P20 inner deadfront is equipped with two removable magnetic carrying handles on its solid front strips and starts in a grooved stand. A ratcheting driver holding the one loose screw starts in a nearby holster. Seeded resets vary the positions of the stand, cover and enclosure. Three repeatable named setups are also available.
scoring: At the end of the trial, 0.25 requires an observed angled entry at both guides, continuous registration while closing, all four cover corners within 1 mm of the mounting plane, and all six shrouds fully through their assigned openings. 0.5 also requires the lower screw seated. Full credit additionally requires all four finger tips at least 30 mm from the plate, the driver at least 15 mm from the screw, and a continuous second of stillness. A drop vetoes credit.
reset_notes: Remove the lower securing screw and stage it in the magnetic driver. Stand the driver in its holster and set the loose inner plate in its stand. The panel stays de-energized and all breakers remain OFF. Fit the two training handles at the marked positions on the front face.
fidelity: Leviton identifies the LR222-LDD enclosure, LRDFC-P20 cover and 45° installation order. Enclosure size is published. Cover and window geometry are scaled from photos; guides, sheet thickness, screw drive and pitch are approximations. PhysX models the free plate and driver. The carried screw follows a kinematic thread only while the aligned tool turns in contact. The two bench handles add 170 g and are rigidly attached in simulation. Physical fit and grip slip await measurement.
run_limit: 3600 control steps (3 min at 20 Hz). The trial also ends as soon as the score reaches 1.0.
scores: Scripted reference 1.0 in 3,393 steps, including screw seating and hand/tool release. Dream-1 (seed 0) scored 0.0 in 3,600 steps on the same scene and scorer. The straight-insertion negative scored 0.0 in 472 steps.
